### Section 2 — `tax_remittance_release` RPC

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION tax_remittance_release(
  p_studio_id            uuid,
  p_location_id          uuid,
  p_jurisdiction         text,
  p_period               text,
  p_release_amount_cents bigint,
  p_idempotency_key      text,
  p_refund_id            text
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
VOLATILE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_ledger RECORD;
  v_existing_release RECORD;
  v_new_collected bigint;
BEGIN
  IF p_release_amount_cents <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tax_remittance_release: release_amount_cents must be > 0';
  END IF;

  -- Idempotency check: a previous release with same idempotency_key + refund_id?
  -- We persist this in tax_remittance_ledger as a structured comment OR a separate releases table.
  -- For S18 simplicity: persist a row in tax_remittance_releases tracking table (created below in Section 4).
  SELECT id, ledger_id, released_cents INTO v_existing_release
    FROM tax_remittance_releases
    WHERE idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key;

  IF FOUND THEN
    SELECT amount_collected_cents INTO v_new_collected
      FROM tax_remittance_ledger WHERE id = v_existing_release.ledger_id;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'ledger_id', v_existing_release.ledger_id,
      'new_collected_cents', v_new_collected,
      'released_cents', v_existing_release.released_cents
    );
  END IF;

  -- Lock the ledger row + verify amount available
  SELECT id, amount_collected_cents
    INTO v_ledger
    FROM tax_remittance_ledger
    WHERE studio_id = p_studio_id
      AND location_id = p_location_id
      AND jurisdiction = p_jurisdiction
      AND period = p_period
    FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tax_remittance_release: ledger row not found for (studio=%, location=%, jurisdiction=%, period=%)',
      p_studio_id, p_location_id, p_jurisdiction, p_period;
  END IF;

  IF v_ledger.amount_collected_cents < p_release_amount_cents THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tax_remittance_release: release % exceeds collected %',
      p_release_amount_cents, v_ledger.amount_collected_cents;
  END IF;

  -- Decrement collected
  UPDATE tax_remittance_ledger
    SET amount_collected_cents = amount_collected_cents - p_release_amount_cents
    WHERE id = v_ledger.id
    RETURNING amount_collected_cents INTO v_new_collected;

  -- Track the release for idempotency + audit
  INSERT INTO tax_remittance_releases (
    ledger_id, idempotency_key, refund_id, released_cents
  ) VALUES (
    v_ledger.id, p_idempotency_key, p_refund_id, p_release_amount_cents
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ledger_id', v_ledger.id,
    'new_collected_cents', v_new_collected,
    'released_cents', p_release_amount_cents
  );
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION tax_remittance_release(uuid, uuid, text, text, bigint, text, text) IS
  'S18. Refund-driven re-credit of tax_remittance_ledger. Idempotent on idempotency_key via tax_remittance_releases tracking table.';

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION tax_remittance_release(uuid, uuid, text, text, bigint, text, text) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION tax_remittance_release(uuid, uuid, text, text, bigint, text, text) TO service_role;
```

### Section 4 — `commission_split_tax_line_reverse` RPC

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_reverse(
  p_parent_tax_line_split_id uuid,
  p_release_tax_cents        bigint,
  p_refund_id                text,
  p_idempotency_key          text
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
VOLATILE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_existing RECORD;
  v_parent RECORD;
  v_total_reversed bigint;
  v_new_reversal_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF p_release_tax_cents <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: release_tax_cents must be > 0';
  END IF;

  -- Idempotency on (parent_tax_line_split_id, refund_id) via UNIQUE partial index (Section 5)
  SELECT id, parent_split_id INTO v_existing
    FROM commission_splits
    WHERE parent_split_id = p_parent_tax_line_split_id
      AND kind = 'reversal'
      AND tax_line_id IS NOT NULL
      AND tax_line_id LIKE 'refund:' || p_refund_id || ':%';

  IF FOUND THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-tax_amount_cents), 0) INTO v_total_reversed
      FROM commission_splits
      WHERE parent_split_id = p_parent_tax_line_split_id
        AND kind = 'reversal';
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'reversal_id', v_existing.id,
      'total_reversed_cents', v_total_reversed,
      'created', false
    );
  END IF;

  -- Load parent tax_line row
  SELECT id, studio_id, booking_id, session_id, artist_id, tax_amount_cents, tax_line_id, jurisdiction, kind
    INTO v_parent
    FROM commission_splits
    WHERE id = p_parent_tax_line_split_id
    FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: parent tax_line split % not found', p_parent_tax_line_split_id;
  END IF;

  IF v_parent.kind <> 'tax_line' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: parent kind must be tax_line, got %', v_parent.kind;
  END IF;

  -- Compute already-reversed amount on parent
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-tax_amount_cents), 0) INTO v_total_reversed
    FROM commission_splits
    WHERE parent_split_id = p_parent_tax_line_split_id
      AND kind = 'reversal';

  -- Bounds check
  IF v_total_reversed + p_release_tax_cents > v_parent.tax_amount_cents THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: cumulative reversal % exceeds parent tax % (already_reversed=%, requested=%)',
      v_total_reversed + p_release_tax_cents, v_parent.tax_amount_cents, v_total_reversed, p_release_tax_cents;
  END IF;

  -- Insert reversal row with negative tax_amount_cents
  INSERT INTO commission_splits (
    studio_id, booking_id, session_id, artist_id,
    base_amount_cents, commission_pct, tip_amount_cents,
    applied_from_pool_cents, stripe_transfer_id,
    kind, parent_split_id,
    tax_amount_cents, tax_line_id, jurisdiction
  ) VALUES (
    v_parent.studio_id, v_parent.booking_id, v_parent.session_id, v_parent.artist_id,
    0, 0, 0, 0, NULL,
    'reversal', p_parent_tax_line_split_id,
    -p_release_tax_cents,
    'refund:' || p_refund_id || ':' || v_parent.tax_line_id,
    v_parent.jurisdiction
  ) RETURNING id INTO v_new_reversal_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'reversal_id', v_new_reversal_id,
    'total_reversed_cents', v_total_reversed + p_release_tax_cents,
    'created', true
  );
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_reverse(uuid, bigint, text, text) IS
  'S18. Refund-driven reversal of a kind=tax_line commission_splits row. Idempotent on (parent_tax_line_split_id, refund_id).';

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_reverse(uuid, bigint, text, text) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_reverse(uuid, bigint, text, text) TO service_role;
```

### Section 5 — UNIQUE partial index for tax_line reversal idempotency

```sql
-- Per Sage S17 launch recommendation: UNIQUE on (parent_split_id, tax_line_id, refund_id) for replay safety.
-- We encode refund_id into tax_line_id (format: 'refund:<refund_id>:<original_tax_line_id>') for kind='reversal' rows.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uniq_commission_splits_tax_line_reversal
  ON commission_splits (parent_split_id, tax_line_id)
  WHERE kind = 'reversal' AND tax_line_id LIKE 'refund:%';
```

### Section 6 — Update `commission_splits_drift_check` to add Leg 4

```sql
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(p_since_timestamp timestamptz)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_pis_missing jsonb;
  v_disputes_missing jsonb;
  v_charges_missing_tax_line jsonb;
  v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- Leg 1 (S17): PIs missing kind='split' (unchanged from 20260508110000)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'payment_intent_id', sc.payment_intent_id,
    'charge_id', sc.charge_id,
    'studio_id', sc.studio_id,
    'created_at', sc.created_at
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_pis_missing
  FROM stripe_charges sc
  LEFT JOIN commission_splits cs
    ON cs.booking_id = sc.booking_id AND cs.kind = 'split'
  WHERE sc.status = 'succeeded'
    AND sc.created_at >= p_since_timestamp
    AND cs.id IS NULL
    AND sc.booking_id IS NOT NULL;

  -- Leg 2 (S17): disputes missing reversal (unchanged)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'dispute_id', sd.dispute_id,
    'charge_id', sd.charge_id,
    'studio_id', sd.studio_id,
    'resolved_at', sd.resolved_at
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_disputes_missing
  FROM stripe_disputes sd
  WHERE sd.status = 'lost'
    AND sd.resolved_at >= p_since_timestamp
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM commission_splits cs
      WHERE cs.kind = 'reversal'
        AND cs.created_at >= sd.resolved_at - interval '1 hour'
        AND cs.created_at <= sd.resolved_at + interval '24 hours'
        AND cs.studio_id = sd.studio_id
        AND cs.booking_id IN (
          SELECT booking_id FROM stripe_charges WHERE charge_id = sd.charge_id LIMIT 1
        )
    );

  -- Leg 3 (S17): charges with tax > 0 missing tax_line attribution (unchanged)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'payment_intent_id', sc.payment_intent_id,
    'charge_id', sc.charge_id,
    'studio_id', sc.studio_id,
    'tax_amount_cents', sc.tax_amount_cents
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_charges_missing_tax_line
  FROM stripe_charges sc
  INNER JOIN commission_splits parent
    ON parent.booking_id = sc.booking_id AND parent.kind = 'split'
  LEFT JOIN commission_splits taxlines
    ON taxlines.parent_split_id = parent.id AND taxlines.kind = 'tax_line'
  WHERE sc.status = 'succeeded'
    AND sc.created_at >= p_since_timestamp
    AND sc.booking_id IS NOT NULL
    AND sc.tax_amount_cents > 0
    AND taxlines.id IS NULL;

  -- Leg 4 (S18 NEW): refunds that reversed parent split but missed tax_line proportional reversal.
  -- Find kind='reversal' rows with refund_id encoded in tax_line_id, then check that EVERY tax_line child
  -- of the corresponding parent split also has a matching reversal under the same refund_id.
  -- Simpler: for charges with refunds (status='refunded' or 'partially_refunded') that have tax_line rows,
  -- check that there's at least one matching tax_line reversal.
  WITH refunded_charges AS (
    SELECT sc.charge_id, sc.payment_intent_id, sc.booking_id, sc.studio_id, parent.id AS parent_split_id
    FROM stripe_charges sc
    INNER JOIN commission_splits parent
      ON parent.booking_id = sc.booking_id AND parent.kind = 'split'
    WHERE sc.status IN ('refunded', 'partially_refunded')
      AND sc.created_at >= p_since_timestamp
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM commission_splits taxlines
        WHERE taxlines.parent_split_id = parent.id AND taxlines.kind = 'tax_line'
      )
  ),
  base_reversals AS (
    SELECT cs.parent_split_id, COUNT(*) AS reversal_count
    FROM commission_splits cs
    INNER JOIN refunded_charges rc ON cs.parent_split_id = rc.parent_split_id
    WHERE cs.kind = 'reversal'
      AND (cs.tax_line_id IS NULL OR cs.tax_line_id NOT LIKE 'refund:%')
    GROUP BY cs.parent_split_id
  ),
  tax_reversals AS (
    SELECT cs.parent_split_id, COUNT(*) AS tax_reversal_count
    FROM commission_splits cs
    INNER JOIN commission_splits parent_taxline ON cs.parent_split_id = parent_taxline.id
    INNER JOIN refunded_charges rc ON parent_taxline.parent_split_id = rc.parent_split_id
    WHERE cs.kind = 'reversal'
      AND parent_taxline.kind = 'tax_line'
    GROUP BY cs.parent_split_id
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'refund_id', '',
    'payment_intent_id', rc.payment_intent_id,
    'studio_id', rc.studio_id,
    'missing_jurisdictions', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(taxlines.jurisdiction), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM commission_splits taxlines
      WHERE taxlines.parent_split_id = rc.parent_split_id
        AND taxlines.kind = 'tax_line'
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM commission_splits rev
          WHERE rev.parent_split_id = taxlines.id
            AND rev.kind = 'reversal'
        )
    )
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal
  FROM refunded_charges rc
  INNER JOIN base_reversals br ON br.parent_split_id = rc.parent_split_id
  LEFT JOIN tax_reversals tr ON tr.parent_split_id = rc.parent_split_id
  WHERE COALESCE(tr.tax_reversal_count, 0) = 0;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'pis_missing_split', v_pis_missing,
    'disputes_missing_reversal', v_disputes_missing,
    'charges_missing_tax_line', v_charges_missing_tax_line,
    'refunds_missing_tax_reversal', v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal
  );
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) IS
  'S18. 4-leg drift detector: PIs missing split, disputes missing reversal, charges missing tax_line, refunds missing tax_line reversal.';

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) TO service_role;
```

## Hard rules

1. Function names match `RPC` constants exactly.
2. `p_snake_case` params matching contracts.ts camelCase.
3. Return jsonb matches `*Result` interfaces.
4. `SECURITY DEFINER` + `VOLATILE` on writes; `STABLE` on read-only drift_check.
5. GRANT to `service_role` ONLY.
6. `SELECT FOR UPDATE` on locked rows.
7. CHECK constraints honor reversal exemption (negatives allowed only when `kind='reversal'`).
8. Idempotent migration — `CREATE OR REPLACE`, `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS`, `DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS ... CREATE`.
9. DOWN section symmetric.

## Verification

After writing:
- `tip_pool_enabled` column added (boolean default false NOT NULL).
- 2 new RPCs (commission_split_tax_line_reverse + tax_remittance_release).
- 1 new tracking table (tax_remittance_releases) with RLS service-role only.
- 1 new UNIQUE partial index for tax_line reversal idempotency.
- drift_check now has 4 legs.

## Output

Report:
- Migration filename + line count.
- Schema changes summary (column + table + indexes).
- 2 new RPCs + drift_check extended to 4 legs.
- Any deviations.

DO NOT TOUCH:
- `lib/payments/contracts.ts` (just edited)
- App routes / components / tests
- Other migrations
- workers/cron/

GO.

256	    FROM commission_splits

350	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(

354	LANGUAGE plpgsql
355	STABLE
356	SECURITY DEFINER
357	SET search_path = public
358	AS $$
359	DECLARE
360	  v_pis_missing         jsonb;
361	  v_disputes_missing    jsonb;
362	BEGIN
363	  IF p_since_timestamp IS NULL THEN
364	    RAISE EXCEPTION
365	      'commission_splits_drift_check: p_since_timestamp must not be null';
366	  END IF;
367	
368	  -- ── Leg 1: Succeeded PIs that have no commission_splits row of kind='split' ──
369	  -- A succeeded stripe_charge with a booking_id MUST have generated a commission_splits
370	  -- row of kind='split'. Missing rows indicate the webhook handler failed after
371	  -- recording the charge but before recording the split.
372	  SELECT COALESCE(
373	    jsonb_agg(
374	      jsonb_build_object(
375	        'payment_intent_id', sc.payment_intent_id,
376	        'charge_id',         sc.charge_id,
377	        'studio_id',         sc.studio_id,
378	        'created_at',        sc.created_at
379	      )
380	      ORDER BY sc.created_at
381	    ),
382	    '[]'::jsonb
383	  )
384	  INTO v_pis_missing
385	  FROM stripe_charges sc
386	  LEFT JOIN commission_splits cs
387	    ON  cs.booking_id = sc.booking_id
388	    AND cs.kind       = 'split'
389	  WHERE sc.status     = 'succeeded'
390	    AND sc.created_at >= p_since_timestamp
391	    AND sc.booking_id IS NOT NULL
392	    AND cs.id         IS NULL;
393	
394	  -- ── Leg 2: Lost disputes without a corresponding kind='reversal' row ─────────
395	  -- A dispute that closed 'lost' MUST trigger a commission split reversal.
396	  -- We use a heuristic time window (resolved_at ± 24h) to match reversals
397	  -- against disputes via the studio + booking join through stripe_charges.
398	  -- Cron should alert and trigger manual repair on any returned rows.
399	  SELECT COALESCE(
400	    jsonb_agg(
401	      jsonb_build_object(
402	        'dispute_id',   sd.dispute_id,
403	        'charge_id',    sd.charge_id,
404	        'studio_id',    sd.studio_id,
405	        'resolved_at',  sd.resolved_at
406	      )
407	      ORDER BY sd.resolved_at
408	    ),
409	    '[]'::jsonb
410	  )
411	  INTO v_disputes_missing
412	  FROM stripe_disputes sd
413	  WHERE sd.status      = 'lost'
414	    AND sd.resolved_at >= p_since_timestamp
415	    AND NOT EXISTS (
416	      SELECT 1
417	        FROM commission_splits cs
418	       WHERE cs.kind       = 'reversal'
419	         AND cs.studio_id  = sd.studio_id
420	         AND cs.created_at >= sd.resolved_at - interval '1 hour'
421	         AND cs.created_at <= sd.resolved_at + interval '24 hours'
422	         AND cs.booking_id IN (
423	           SELECT sc_inner.booking_id
424	             FROM stripe_charges sc_inner
425	            WHERE sc_inner.charge_id  = sd.charge_id
426	              AND sc_inner.booking_id IS NOT NULL
427	            LIMIT 1
428	         )
429	    );
430	
431	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
432	    'pis_missing_split',        v_pis_missing,
433	    'disputes_missing_reversal', v_disputes_missing
434	  );
435	END;
436	$$;

441	  'kind=split row, (2) lost disputes missing a kind=reversal row. '
442	  'Caller (cron) logs + alerts; does NOT auto-repair. '
443	  'Call with p_since_timestamp = now() - interval ''24 hours'' for daily sweeps.';

-- SECTION 3 — RPC: tax_remittance_release
--
-- Spec : TaxRemittanceReleaseArgs → TaxRemittanceReleaseResult
-- Name : RPC.TAX_REMITTANCE_RELEASE = 'tax_remittance_release'
-- Params:
--   p_studio_id            uuid
--   p_location_id          uuid
--   p_jurisdiction         text
--   p_period               text
--   p_release_amount_cents bigint
--   p_idempotency_key      text
--   p_refund_id            text
-- Returns: jsonb { ledger_id, new_collected_cents, released_cents }
-- Idempotent: UNIQUE tax_remittance_releases.idempotency_key
-- Volatile: writes to tax_remittance_ledger + tax_remittance_releases
-- Grant: service_role ONLY
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION tax_remittance_release(
  p_studio_id            uuid,
  p_location_id          uuid,
  p_jurisdiction         text,
  p_period               text,
  p_release_amount_cents bigint,
  p_idempotency_key      text,
  p_refund_id            text
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
VOLATILE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_ledger           RECORD;
  v_existing_release RECORD;
  v_new_collected    bigint;
BEGIN
  -- ── Input validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF p_release_amount_cents IS NULL OR p_release_amount_cents <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'tax_remittance_release: release_amount_cents must be > 0, got %',
      p_release_amount_cents;
  END IF;

  IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR length(trim(p_idempotency_key)) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'tax_remittance_release: idempotency_key must not be null or empty';
  END IF;

  IF p_refund_id IS NULL OR length(trim(p_refund_id)) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'tax_remittance_release: refund_id must not be null or empty';
  END IF;

  -- ── Idempotency check ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  -- If a previous call with the same idempotency_key already committed,
  -- return the cached result without touching the ledger again.
  SELECT trr.id, trr.ledger_id, trr.released_cents
    INTO v_existing_release
    FROM tax_remittance_releases trr
   WHERE trr.idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key;

  IF FOUND THEN
    SELECT trl.amount_collected_cents
      INTO v_new_collected
      FROM tax_remittance_ledger trl
     WHERE trl.id = v_existing_release.ledger_id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'ledger_id',           v_existing_release.ledger_id,
      'new_collected_cents', v_new_collected,
      'released_cents',      v_existing_release.released_cents
    );
  END IF;

  -- ── Lock ledger row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  -- SELECT FOR UPDATE serialises concurrent releases on the same ledger row.
  SELECT trl.id, trl.amount_collected_cents
    INTO v_ledger
    FROM tax_remittance_ledger trl
   WHERE trl.studio_id    = p_studio_id
     AND trl.location_id  = p_location_id
     AND trl.jurisdiction = p_jurisdiction
     AND trl.period       = p_period
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'tax_remittance_release: ledger row not found for '
      '(studio=%, location=%, jurisdiction=%, period=%)',
      p_studio_id, p_location_id, p_jurisdiction, p_period;
  END IF;

  -- ── Bounds check ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  -- Prevents amount_collected_cents going negative — the table CHECK constraint
  -- (tax_remittance_ledger_collected_pos) would also catch this, but an explicit
  -- exception is far more informative for ops debugging.
  IF v_ledger.amount_collected_cents < p_release_amount_cents THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'tax_remittance_release: release % exceeds collected % '
      '(ledger_id=%, studio=%, jurisdiction=%, period=%)',
      p_release_amount_cents,
      v_ledger.amount_collected_cents,
      v_ledger.id,
      p_studio_id,
      p_jurisdiction,
      p_period;
  END IF;

  -- ── Decrement collected ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  UPDATE tax_remittance_ledger
     SET amount_collected_cents = amount_collected_cents - p_release_amount_cents
   WHERE id = v_ledger.id
   RETURNING amount_collected_cents INTO v_new_collected;

  -- ── Record release for idempotency + audit ──────────────────────────────────
  INSERT INTO tax_remittance_releases (
    ledger_id,
    idempotency_key,
    refund_id,
    released_cents
  ) VALUES (
    v_ledger.id,
    p_idempotency_key,
    p_refund_id,
    p_release_amount_cents
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ledger_id',           v_ledger.id,
    'new_collected_cents', v_new_collected,
    'released_cents',      p_release_amount_cents
  );
END;
$$;

-- Name : RPC.COMMISSION_SPLIT_TAX_LINE_REVERSE = 'commission_split_tax_line_reverse'
-- Params:
--   p_parent_tax_line_split_id uuid   — id of the kind='tax_line' row to reverse
--   p_release_tax_cents        bigint — amount to reverse (positive integer)
--   p_refund_id                text   — Stripe refund_xxx identifier
--   p_idempotency_key          text   — caller idempotency key (unused for DB check
--                                       — DB idempotency is via the UNIQUE index;
--                                       param retained for API contract parity)
-- Returns: jsonb { reversal_id, total_reversed_cents, created }
-- Idempotent: uniq_commission_splits_tax_line_reversal on
--             (parent_split_id, 'refund:<refund_id>:<original_tax_line_id>')
--             WHERE kind='reversal'
-- Volatile: INSERTs into commission_splits
-- Grant: service_role ONLY
--
-- Design notes:
--   tax_line_id on the reversal row is 'refund:<refund_id>:<original_tax_line_id>'.
--   This encodes both the refund context and original tax_line_id in a single
--   indexed column, enabling the UNIQUE partial index to catch replays.
--   tax_amount_cents is stored as a negative value (ledger netting pattern, CC4).
--   The commission_splits_tax_amount_cents_check constraint allows negatives
--   only when kind='reversal', which this row satisfies.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_reverse(
  p_parent_tax_line_split_id uuid,
  p_release_tax_cents        bigint,
  p_refund_id                text,
  p_idempotency_key          text
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
VOLATILE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_existing        RECORD;
  v_parent          RECORD;
  v_already_reversed bigint;
  v_reversal_tax_line_id text;
  v_new_reversal_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- ── Input validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IF p_release_tax_cents IS NULL OR p_release_tax_cents <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: release_tax_cents must be > 0, got %',
      p_release_tax_cents;
  END IF;

  IF p_refund_id IS NULL OR length(trim(p_refund_id)) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: refund_id must not be null or empty';
  END IF;

  IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR length(trim(p_idempotency_key)) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: idempotency_key must not be null or empty';
  END IF;

  -- ── Load parent tax_line row first (needed for reversal tax_line_id encoding) ──
  -- SELECT FOR UPDATE prevents concurrent reversals racing on the same parent.
  SELECT cs.id,
         cs.studio_id,
         cs.booking_id,
         cs.session_id,
         cs.artist_id,
         cs.tax_amount_cents,
         cs.tax_line_id,
         cs.jurisdiction,
         cs.kind
    INTO v_parent
    FROM commission_splits cs
   WHERE cs.id = p_parent_tax_line_split_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: parent tax_line split % not found',
      p_parent_tax_line_split_id;
  END IF;

  IF v_parent.kind <> 'tax_line' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: parent kind must be ''tax_line'', got ''%'' '
      'for id=%',
      v_parent.kind,
      p_parent_tax_line_split_id;
  END IF;

  -- ── Build encoded tax_line_id for the reversal row ──────────────────────────
  -- Format: 'refund:<refund_id>:<original_tax_line_id>'
  -- Drives the UNIQUE partial index uniq_commission_splits_tax_line_reversal.
  v_reversal_tax_line_id := 'refund:' || p_refund_id || ':' || v_parent.tax_line_id;

  -- ── Idempotency check via UNIQUE index ──────────────────────────────────────
  -- If a reversal row already exists with this (parent_split_id, encoded tax_line_id)
  -- under kind='reversal', the call is a replay — return cached result.
  SELECT cs.id
    INTO v_existing
    FROM commission_splits cs
   WHERE cs.parent_split_id = p_parent_tax_line_split_id
     AND cs.kind            = 'reversal'
     AND cs.tax_line_id     = v_reversal_tax_line_id;

  IF FOUND THEN
    -- Compute total reversed for informational return
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-cs.tax_amount_cents), 0)
      INTO v_already_reversed
      FROM commission_splits cs
     WHERE cs.parent_split_id = p_parent_tax_line_split_id
       AND cs.kind            = 'reversal';

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'reversal_id',          v_existing.id,
      'total_reversed_cents', v_already_reversed,
      'created',              false
    );
  END IF;

  -- ── Cumulative bounds check ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  -- Sum existing reversals (stored as negative values — negate to get positive total).
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-cs.tax_amount_cents), 0)
    INTO v_already_reversed
    FROM commission_splits cs
   WHERE cs.parent_split_id = p_parent_tax_line_split_id
     AND cs.kind            = 'reversal';

  IF v_already_reversed + p_release_tax_cents > v_parent.tax_amount_cents THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'commission_split_tax_line_reverse: cumulative reversal % would exceed '
      'parent tax_amount_cents % (already_reversed=%, requested=%, parent_id=%)',
      v_already_reversed + p_release_tax_cents,
      v_parent.tax_amount_cents,
      v_already_reversed,
      p_release_tax_cents,
      p_parent_tax_line_split_id;
  END IF;

  -- ── Insert reversal row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  -- Non-monetary fields are zero — this row's sole purpose is tax reversal.
  -- tax_amount_cents is negative (ledger netting pattern, CC4).
  -- commission_splits_tax_amount_cents_check allows negatives when kind='reversal'.
  INSERT INTO commission_splits (
    studio_id,
    booking_id,
    session_id,
    artist_id,
    base_amount_cents,
    commission_pct,
    tip_amount_cents,
    applied_from_pool_cents,
    stripe_transfer_id,
    kind,
    parent_split_id,
    tax_amount_cents,
    tax_line_id,
    jurisdiction
  ) VALUES (
    v_parent.studio_id,
    v_parent.booking_id,
    v_parent.session_id,
    v_parent.artist_id,
    0,                              -- base_amount_cents: zero for tax-reversal rows
    0,                              -- commission_pct: zero for tax-reversal rows
    0,                              -- tip_amount_cents: zero for tax-reversal rows
    0,                              -- applied_from_pool_cents: zero for tax-reversal rows
    NULL,                           -- stripe_transfer_id: no transfer for tax reversal
    'reversal',
    p_parent_tax_line_split_id,
    -p_release_tax_cents,           -- negative: ledger netting pattern (CC4)
    v_reversal_tax_line_id,         -- 'refund:<refund_id>:<original_tax_line_id>'
    v_parent.jurisdiction
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_new_reversal_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'reversal_id',          v_new_reversal_id,
    'total_reversed_cents', v_already_reversed + p_release_tax_cents,
    'created',              true
  );
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_reverse(uuid, bigint, text, text) IS
  'S18. Refund-driven reversal of a kind=tax_line commission_splits row. '
  'Inserts a kind=reversal child row with tax_amount_cents=-p_release_tax_cents '
  '(ledger netting pattern, CC4). '
  'Idempotent on (parent_tax_line_split_id, refund_id) via '
  'uniq_commission_splits_tax_line_reversal UNIQUE partial index. '
  'tax_line_id on the reversal row is encoded as '
  '''refund:<refund_id>:<original_tax_line_id>'' to carry refund context. '
  'Cumulative bounds check prevents over-reversal of parent tax amount.';

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_reverse(uuid, bigint, text, text) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION commission_split_tax_line_reverse(uuid, bigint, text, text) TO service_role;


-- =============================================================================
-- SECTION 6 — Replace commission_splits_drift_check with 4-leg version
--
-- Leg 1 (S17 unchanged): succeeded PIs missing kind='split' row.
-- Leg 2 (S17 unchanged): lost disputes missing kind='reversal' row.
-- Leg 3 (S17 unchanged): charges with tax_amount_cents > 0 missing kind='tax_line' children.
-- Leg 4 (S18 NEW): refunded/partially_refunded charges whose parent split has tax_line
--   children but none of those tax_line children have a kind='reversal' descendant.
--   Indicates Track A's commission_split_tax_line_reverse call failed post-refund.
--
-- Stability: STABLE (read-only across all 4 legs).
-- =============================================================================

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(p_since_timestamp timestamptz)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_pis_missing                   jsonb;
  v_disputes_missing              jsonb;
  v_charges_missing_tax_line      jsonb;
  v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal  jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF p_since_timestamp IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'commission_splits_drift_check: p_since_timestamp must not be null';
  END IF;

  -- ── Leg 1 (S17): succeeded PIs missing kind='split' ─────────────────────────
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'payment_intent_id', sc.payment_intent_id,
        'charge_id',         sc.charge_id,
        'studio_id',         sc.studio_id,
        'created_at',        sc.created_at
      )
      ORDER BY sc.created_at
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_pis_missing
  FROM stripe_charges sc
  LEFT JOIN commission_splits cs
    ON  cs.booking_id = sc.booking_id
    AND cs.kind       = 'split'
  WHERE sc.status     = 'succeeded'
    AND sc.created_at >= p_since_timestamp
    AND sc.booking_id IS NOT NULL
    AND cs.id         IS NULL;

  -- ── Leg 2 (S17): lost disputes missing kind='reversal' ───────────────────────
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'dispute_id',  sd.dispute_id,
        'charge_id',   sd.charge_id,
        'studio_id',   sd.studio_id,
        'resolved_at', sd.resolved_at
      )
      ORDER BY sd.resolved_at
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_disputes_missing
  FROM stripe_disputes sd
  WHERE sd.status      = 'lost'
    AND sd.resolved_at >= p_since_timestamp
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM commission_splits cs
       WHERE cs.kind       = 'reversal'
         AND cs.studio_id  = sd.studio_id
         AND cs.created_at >= sd.resolved_at - interval '1 hour'
         AND cs.created_at <= sd.resolved_at + interval '24 hours'
         AND cs.booking_id IN (
               SELECT sc_inner.booking_id
                 FROM stripe_charges sc_inner
                WHERE sc_inner.charge_id  = sd.charge_id
                  AND sc_inner.booking_id IS NOT NULL
                LIMIT 1
             )
    );

  -- ── Leg 3 (S17): charges with tax > 0 missing tax_line attribution ───────────
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'payment_intent_id', sc.payment_intent_id,
        'charge_id',         sc.charge_id,
        'studio_id',         sc.studio_id,
        'tax_amount_cents',  sc.tax_amount_cents
      )
      ORDER BY sc.created_at
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_charges_missing_tax_line
  FROM stripe_charges sc
  INNER JOIN commission_splits parent
    ON  parent.booking_id = sc.booking_id
    AND parent.kind       = 'split'
  LEFT JOIN commission_splits taxlines
    ON  taxlines.parent_split_id = parent.id
    AND taxlines.kind            = 'tax_line'
  WHERE sc.status         = 'succeeded'
    AND sc.created_at    >= p_since_timestamp
    AND sc.booking_id    IS NOT NULL
    AND sc.tax_amount_cents > 0
    AND taxlines.id      IS NULL;

  -- ── Leg 4 (S18): refunded charges with tax_line children missing tax reversals ─
  --
  -- Logic:
  --   1. Find stripe_charges with status IN ('refunded', 'partially_refunded')
  --      created since p_since_timestamp.
  --   2. For each such charge, find the parent kind='split' commission_splits row.
  --   3. Check that every kind='tax_line' child of that parent split has at least
  --      one kind='reversal' grandchild (i.e. a row with parent_split_id = taxline.id
  --      and kind='reversal').
  --   4. Return charges where at least one tax_line child has NO reversal descendant,
  --      including the list of un-reversed jurisdictions for alerting.
  --
  -- Note: we require the parent split to have been recorded (kind='split' child exists).
  -- Charges missing the parent split entirely are caught by Leg 1.
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'payment_intent_id',    sc.payment_intent_id,
        'charge_id',            sc.charge_id,
        'studio_id',            sc.studio_id,
        'missing_jurisdictions', (
          SELECT COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(tl.jurisdiction ORDER BY tl.jurisdiction),
            '[]'::jsonb
          )
          FROM commission_splits tl
         WHERE tl.parent_split_id = parent.id
           AND tl.kind            = 'tax_line'
           AND NOT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1
                   FROM commission_splits rev
                  WHERE rev.parent_split_id = tl.id
                    AND rev.kind            = 'reversal'
               )
        )
      )
      ORDER BY sc.created_at
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  INTO v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal
  FROM stripe_charges sc
  INNER JOIN commission_splits parent
    ON  parent.booking_id = sc.booking_id
    AND parent.kind       = 'split'
  WHERE sc.status        IN ('refunded', 'partially_refunded')
    AND sc.created_at   >= p_since_timestamp
    AND sc.booking_id   IS NOT NULL
    -- At least one tax_line child exists (charges with no tax don't need reversals)
    AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
            FROM commission_splits tl
           WHERE tl.parent_split_id = parent.id
             AND tl.kind            = 'tax_line'
        )
    -- At least one tax_line child is missing its reversal
    AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
            FROM commission_splits tl
           WHERE tl.parent_split_id = parent.id
             AND tl.kind            = 'tax_line'
             AND NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                     FROM commission_splits rev
                    WHERE rev.parent_split_id = tl.id
                      AND rev.kind            = 'reversal'
                 )
        );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'pis_missing_split',              v_pis_missing,
    'disputes_missing_reversal',      v_disputes_missing,
    'charges_missing_tax_line',       v_charges_missing_tax_line,
    'refunds_missing_tax_reversal',   v_refunds_missing_tax_reversal
  );
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) IS
  'S18. Read-only drift detector for reconciliation cron. 4 legs: '
  '(1) succeeded PIs missing kind=split, '
  '(2) lost disputes missing kind=reversal, '
  '(3) charges with tax_amount_cents > 0 missing tax_line attribution, '
  '(4) refunded/partially_refunded charges with tax_line children that have no '
  'kind=reversal descendant (tax_line reversal missed post-refund). '
  'Caller (cron) logs + alerts; does NOT auto-repair. '
  'Call with p_since_timestamp = now() - interval ''24 hours'' for daily sweeps.';

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION commission_splits_drift_check(timestamptz) TO service_role;
